results.title: Historia współpracująca : czyli historycy i historyczki w relacjach społecznych

abstracts.content: Our article is a response to the question of the "defense of the scientific status of history". Our aim is to partially justify the position that history can benefit from recognizing the relationships that academic historians establish in the research process with the actors involved. We describe these emerging relationships using the concept of collaborative history. With this concept, we aim to highlight a less visible dimension of historical research, which comprises a range of dynamic social relationships that it co-creates, establishes, and reconfigures. We discuss the collaborations in which historians engage using four examples of research attentive to their own social networking. These discussions reveal the social relationships in which research is conducted, the tensions and negotiations that occur among its actors, the collaborative practices that drive and inspire actions, and the actions, omissions, or independent situations that hinder or prevent them. The proposed perspective of collaborative history and the discussed examples suggest three historical research practices: autoethnography, research contract, and reading contract. In our view, the proposed approach has four advantages: first, it suggests a change in the vocabulary of the discussion about the relationships in which history operates-replacing war metaphors of defense, attack, struggle, intervention, etc., with a language of understanding, negotiation, connection, participation, and co-responsibility; second, it draws greater attention to the complex social connections of historical research practices; third, it appreciates the painstaking, repetitive, and undervalued components of research; and finally, it acknowledges its limitations: non-standardization and costliness.

The article concerns the history of the formation of Polish phraseological thought from the mid-nineteenth century to the present day. The author focused in particular on three threads: 1) the development of phraseological terminology and the scope of the term frazeologia; 2) the history of the classification of phraseological units; 3) phraseology in the lexicographical perspective (quantitative aspect). One of the postulates proposed in the article is the inclusion of Jan Karłowicz’s work Przyczynki do projektu wielkiego słownika polskiego [Contributions to the project of a great Polish dictionary] (1876) in the research on phraseology.

results.title: Wpływ technologii rzeczywistości wirtualnej i rozszerzonej na obraz i schemat ciała w perspektywie fenomenologicznej

abstracts.content: The human body plays a significant and even crucial role in cognition. This aspect was emphasised by Maurice Merleau-Ponty in his phenomenology. He showed that cognition is possible through the human body. However, it does not have to be limited to the biological body, thus many external objects can be inscribed in corporeality, thanks to which cognition is also possible, consisting in finding a relationship with the physical world. His intuitions presented in "Phenomenology of perception" resulted in numerous concepts in the cognitive sciences, such as embodied cognition. Many years later, an analysis of the body’s functionality is presented by Shaun Gallagher, who makes a phenomenological distinction between body schema and body image. The body schema refers to the processes that constantly regulate body posture and the ability to move, i.e. sensory-motor processes, functioning without reflective awareness or the need for perceptual monitoring, while the body image concerns the subject’s perceptual experience of his own body, conceptual understanding of corporeality and the subject’s emotional attitude towards his own body. The division proposed by Gallagher is interesting because it allows us to ask whether, under the impact of various technological solutions, the body schema and image change themselves. In this chapter, an analysis will be shown of how the impact of technologies such as virtual reality and augmented reality expands the subject’s sense of corporeality, thus affecting and changing human cognition.

results.title: Representations of the Sanhedrin in post-Byzantine art following the example of a 19th century icon in Uličskié Krivé

abstracts.content: In Slovakia, two nineteenth-century icons of the Passion of Christ are found at Archangel Michael Orthodox Church in the village of Uličskié Krivé and Humenne museum in the village of Nová Sedlica. They present scenes of The Unjust Trial of Christ. Christ is tried by Pilate, Caiaphas and members of the Sanhedrin. In the hall, there are several judges holding scrolls with the texts of the death sentence. This iconographic theme is not known in Byzantine art and comes from the West. This paper will show the original details of this presentation and discuss its reception in post-Byzantine art in Central and Eastern Europe.

abstracts.content: Celem niniejszego rozdziału jest wyjaśnienie pojęć, źródeł, zasad i głównych zagadnień składających się na współczesne prawo przeciwwojenne. Zrozumienie istoty tego prawa wymaga zarówno znajomości stosownej terminologii (czyli takich pojęć, jak użycie siły, zagrożenie pokoju, naruszenie pokoju i akt agresji), jak i historii kształtowania się zakazu użycia siły w prawie międzynarodowym, począwszy od koncepcji „wojny sprawiedliwej”, poprzez klasyczne „prawo do wojny”, aż do obecnego ius contra bellum. Najważniejszą zasadą prawa przeciwwojennego jest zakaz użycia siły i groźby jej użycia, wyrażony w art. 2.4 Karty NZ, wiążą się z nim jednak pozostałe podstawowe zasady ONZ, jak choćby zasada nieinterwencji w wewnętrzne sprawy państw. Najważniejszym zaś źródłem omawianego prawa jest Karta NZ, której istotne uzupełnienie stanowi międzynarodowe prawo zwyczajowe. W rozdziale przedstawiono także wyjątki od zakazu użycia siły – akcję zbrojną podjętą przez Radę Bezpieczeństwa ONZ na podstawie rozdziału VII Karty (omówioną w kontekście systemu bezpieczeństwa zbiorowego) oraz prawo do indywidualnej lub zbiorowej samoobrony. Odniesiono się także do kontrowersyjnych przypadków jednostronnego użycia siły poza ramami Karty oraz do współczesnych wyzwań prawa przeciwwojennego i jego możliwych kierunków rozwoju. Rozdział wieńczy sumaryczne zestawienie najważniejszych wiadomości na temat prawa przeciwwojennego.

The purpose of this chapter is to explain the concepts, sources, principles, and main issues that constitute contemporary law on the prevention of war. Understanding the essence of this body of law requires familiarity with relevant terminology (such as the use of force, threat to peace, breach of peace, and act of aggression) as well as the historical development of the prohibition of the use of force in international law. This evolution spans from the concept of a "just war" through the classical "right to war" to the modern jus contra bellum. The cornerstone principle of the law on the prevention of war is the prohibition of the use of force and the threat of its use, as expressed in Article 2(4) of the UN Charter. This principle is closely linked to other fundamental principles of the United Nations, such as the principle of non-intervention in the internal affairs of states. The primary source of the discussed body of law is the UN Charter, supplemented by customary international law. The chapter also examines exceptions to the prohibition of the use of force, including armed actions authorized by the UN Security Council under Chapter VII of the Charter (analyzed in the context of the collective security system) and the right to individual or collective self-defence. Furthermore, it addresses controversial instances of unilateral use of force outside the framework of the Charter, as well as contemporary challenges to jus contra bellum and its potential directions of development. The chapter concludes with a summary of the key information about the law on the prevention of war.

abstracts.content: Praca poświęcona jest metodyce pracy pisarskiej anonimowego skryby, który przepisał antyheretyckie pisma Stanisława ze Skarbimierza. Jego charakter pisma można odnaleźć w 15 rękopisach znajdujących się w Bibliotece Jagiellońskiej. Na podstawie analizy kodykologicznej tekstów przez niego przepisanych udało się ustalić czas jego działalności na lata 30. i 40. XV w.  oraz jego zleceniodawców, którymi byli dwaj profesorzy - Jan Dąbrówka i Tomasz Strzępiński. Charakterystycznymi cechami stylu jego pracy było kopiowanie tekstów w sposób staranny, czytelny i możliwie bez żadnych dodatkowych ingerencji. Za swoją pracę otrzymywał wysokie wynagrodzenie, co dowodzi, że był skrybą zawodowym.

The work is devoted to the writing methodology of an anonymous scribe who copied the anti-heretical writings of Stanisław of Skarbimierz. His handwriting can be found in 15 manuscripts of the Jagiellonian Library. Based on a codicological analysis of the texts he copied, it was possible to determine the period of his activity on the years 30s and 40s of the 15th century and his clients, who were two professors - Jan Dąbrówka and Tomasz Strzępiński. Copying texts carefully, legibly and possibly without any additional interference were characteristic features of his work style. He received high payment for his work, which proves that he was a professional scribe.

results.title: Labour market research for an ageing workforce in times of digitalisation

abstracts.content: This chapter explores the transformation of labour markets due to digitalisation and its impact on the ageing workforce. The ongoing integration of digital technologies and data across the economy and society affects the content, organisation, design, regulation and protection of work, but also how we learn and develop competencies. Therefore, the company level is significant as it provides ‘the places of work’ and shapes the creation of age-inclusive work and learning environments enabling lifelong learning and extended working lives. Fields of tension in digital labour markets are scrutinised at the macro-, the meso- and micro-level. Necessary changes are discussed to enable a human-centric, age-friendly transformation where no one is left behind. Options comprise adaptations of the work environment, including combating ageism and changes in management approaches and practices, targeted investments in education, training and capacity building for upskilling and reskilling workers, and profound reforms of (social) policy systems.

book.title: The problem of "de facto states" in international relations in Africa

results.title: Controversy over the international subjectivity of "de facto states"

abstracts.content: The article raises the issue of the international legal subjectivity of an entity that cannot yet be categorized as a state, but is nevertheless defined as a de facto state, i.e. a secessionist entity that exercises effective jurisdiction for a long time over the population in a specific territory and can establish relations with other states. The de facto state is also characterized by striving for full constitutional independence and universal international recognition as a sovereign state. The discussion of the legal status of de facto states in the international arena was preceded by an indication and analysis of historical attempts to categorize state entities, with particular emphasis on the concept of the "new state" arising from the regulations of the Covenant of League of Nations. Categories of states distinguished in political science were also indicated, namely: "unrecognized states", "failed states" and "quasi states". An attempt was made to define de facto states and the attributes of the alleged subjectivity of de facto states were discussed, namely ius tractatuum, ius legationis and ius standi. The study shows how much the situation of de facto states differs from the situation of states that are full participants in international relations.

results.title: Large language models technology as a center of knowledge flows in the organization : epistemic management

abstracts.content: Artykuł omawia ideę zarządzania epistemicznego, czyli zarządzania wspieranego technologią tzw. wielkich modeli językowych (Large Language Models, LLM). Proponuje on uporządkowanie procesów przepływu wiedzy w procesie zarządzania z wykorzystaniem technologii LL M. W artykule przypomniano istniejącą, obszerną refleksję nad wiedzą, opartą na fenomenie języka w obszarze hermeneutyki i analizy dyskursu. Refleksja ta jest źródłem uzasadnienia wagi języka i jego manifestacji w postaci tekstu dla istnienia, rozwoju i stosowania wiedzy z perspektywy człowieka, ale może być również wykorzystana do uzasadnienia i zrozumienia analogicznych procesów wiedzy, które zachodzą z wykorzystaniem technologii LL M. W szczególności dowodzi ona trafności podejścia do technologii LL M jako efektywnego przetwarzania wiedzy na poziomie przekraczającym kompetencje ludzkie. W artykule zaproponowano strukturę przepływów wiedzy w organizacji, w której technologia LL M odgrywa centralną rolę. Ze względu na szybkość i objętość przetwarzanych danych technologię LL M można uznać za tzw. innowację przerywającą w dziedzinie zarządzania. W artykule omówiono także specyficzne cechy tej technologii, takie jak nieprzewidywalność czy brak możliwości interpretacji procesu jej powstawania, które mają istotny wpływ na jej odbiór.

The paper discusses the idea of epistemic management, which means management supported by the technology of large language models (LLM) and proposes organizing the processes of knowledge flow in the management process using LLM technology. The paper points to the existing extensive reflection on knowledge, based on the phenomenon of language in the area of hermeneutics and discourse analysis. This reflection is the source of an extensive justification of the role of language and its manifestation in the form of text for the existence, development, and application of knowledge from the human perspective. However, this reflection can also be used to justify and understand analogous knowledge processes that take place using LLM technologies. In particular, this reflection proves the accuracy of the approach to LLM technology as the effective processing of knowledge at a level that exceeds human competencies. In this situation, the paper proposes a structure of knowledge flows in the organization in which LLM technology plays a central role. Due to the speed and volume of processed data, the LLM technology may be considered the so-called disruptive innovation in the field of management. The paper also discusses specific features of this technology, such as unpredictability and uninterpretability, which greatly impact its reception.

results.title: Literatura w kręgu wpływu hezychazmu : "Święty Sergiusz z Radoneża" Borysa Zajcewa

abstracts.content: W pracy nad szkicem hagiograficznym o św. Sergiuszu Borys Zajcew dysponował 500-letnią tradycją żywotopisarsko-kaznodziejską, którą zapoczątkował w 1418 r. uczeń założyciela Ławry Troicko-Siergijewskiej - Epifaniusz Mądry. Jej uwieńczeniem był żywot syntetyzujący dotychczasowy dorobek - autorstwa archimandry Nikona (Rożdiestwieńskiego), opublikowany po raz pierwszy w 1885 r. B. Zajcew ma świadomość fenomenu św. Sergiusza, którego rola wykracza poza ramy historyczne, jest on żywym symbolem o uniwersalnym znaczeniu dla prawosławia i Rosji. Nie przypadkiem pisarz "pierwszej fali" emigracji po rewolucji 1917 r. - w poszukiwaniu oparcia dla siebie i swoich pobratymców – kieruje wzrok ku wielowiekowej tradycji hagiograficznej związanej z Orędownikiem Świętej Rusi i Rosji. W całości szkic ukazał się po raz pierwszy nakładem wydawnictwa YMCA-Press w Paryżu w 1925 r.

In working on a hagiographical sketch about St. Sergius, Boris Zaytsev had at his disposal a 500-year-old tradition of life-writing and preaching, which began in 1418 with Epiphanius the Wise, a disciple of the founder of the Holy Trinity-St. Sergius Lavra. Its culmination was a life synthesizing the previous output - by Archimandrite Nikon (Rozhdestvensky), first published in 1885. B. Zaytsev is aware of the phenomenon of St. Sergius, whose role goes beyond the historical framework; he is a living symbol with universal significance for Orthodoxy and Russia. Not coincidentally, the writer of "the first wave" of emigration after the 1917 revolution - in his search for a foothold for himself and his compatriots - turns his gaze to the centuries-old hagiographic tradition associated with the Advocate of Holy Rus and Russia. In its entirety, the sketch was first published by the YMCA-Press in Paris in 1925.

book.title: The phonetics and phonology of heritage languages

results.title: Phonetics of stop voicing in heritage and homeland Polish

abstracts.content: We investigate acoustic correlates of the laryngeal contrast in intervocalic stops in three speech communities - homeland Polish speakers and first- and second-generation heritage Polish speakers in Toronto. Using a sample of 1,187 tokens extracted from conversational speech, we show that the employment of some parameters signaling laryngeal contrast differs between the homeland and heritage speakers. Some parameters are suppressed (i.e., closure phonation and duration) and some are amplified (i.e., vowel and release duration). We interpret these processes in light of proposals by Flege and Bohn (2021) and Polinsky (2018) regarding contact-induced interaction (i.e., assimilation versus dissimilation between languages). We propose that the interaction between systems occurs at a low level of granularity, that is, at the level of individual phonetic properties of a single phoneme.

abstracts.content: Artykuł ukazuje wkład starofrancuskiej powieści arturiańskiej w kształtowanie cywilizacji europejskiej. Pod wpływem jej oddziaływania, cywilizacja ta - na długie stulecia - została ubogacona o następujące aspekty: etos rycerski (oparty na chrześcijańskiej wizji człowieka i społeczeństwa), ideę solidarności i wdzięczności, entuzjazm odkrywania świata i człowieka, konstruktywną wizję samotności, ubogacającą symbiozę sacrum i profanum, dowartościowanie roli kobiety.

This article discusses the contribution of the Old French Arthurian novel to the shaping of European civilisation. Influenced by this novel, European civilisation was enriched for centuries in various aspects: the ethos of chivalry (rooted in the Christian vision of man and society); the concepts of solidarity and gratitude; a passion of exploration and understanding of both the world and human nature; a constructive view of solitude that enriched symbiosis of the sacred and the profane; the appreciation of the role of women.

results.title: "Lève-toi, Pierre, tue et mange" : de la passion apologétique à un exercice insolite d’exégèse dans la deuxième moitié du XIXe siècle

abstracts.content: "Rise, Peter; kill, and eat" - this troubling invitation, taken from the Acts of the Apostles (X, 13), refers to the famous vision of St. Peter, which precedes the baptism of the first Roman Christian, the centurion Cornelius. While theological tradition sees it as the beginnings of converted Gentilism, many texts in the second half of the 19th century make use of this passage in different contexts, in writings which are not necessarily part of theological studies. Therefore, this biblical passage occupies an important place in the experience of the Jerusalemite pilgrimage and its narrative features. A strange kind of exegesis is also mobilized to plead the cause of vegetarianism or, towards the end of the 19th century, to revisit the tradition of hygienic prescriptions concerning animal food. The paper provides a critical review of the selected texts, highlighting the most interesting cases.

results.title: China's policy on climate and energy towards 2060

abstracts.content: Climate change is one of the biggest challenges facing our planet during the twenty-first century, having a significant impact on ecosystems, economies and communities. It poses a long-term threat that demands international cooperation to combat global warming, while achieving sustainable development. In this regard, the changing role of China in the global climate governance mechanisms has increasingly become an issue of international attention. Currently, China is the largest energy consumer and the largest emitter of greenhouse gases worldwide. In September 2020 Chinese President Xi Jinping announced that China would aim to hit CO2 peak emissions before 2030 and for carbon neutrality by 2060. This chapter describes the current decarbonization process in China. It also discusses how measures of the latest Five-Year Plan obligations are linking to China’s ambition to become carbon neutral by 2060.

It demonstrates that the risk posed to consumers’ mental health by AI systems is real and should be addressed, yet the approach taken by the EU in its AIA Proposal is suboptimal.

results.title: Final excerpt from James Joyce’s "Ulysses" in Lebanese : manuscript presentation and philological commentary

abstracts.content: Artykuł stanowi wkład do dialektologii arabskiej oraz studiów nad współczesną produkcją artystyczną w arabskim dialekcie libańskim. Artykuł przedstawia niepublikowany rękopis tłumaczenia fragmentu „Ulissesa” Jamesa Joyce’a: końcowego ustępu monologu Molly Bloom, napisanego w narracyjnej technice strumienia świadomości. Tłumaczem wersji libańskiej jest Amir Hlayyil, maronicki poeta i etnograf z Kfar Shimy. Artykuł zawiera porównanie dwóch wersji przekładu, komentarz dialektologiczny wraz z analizą pisowni w rękopisie, tekst drukowany w alfabecie arabskim ostatecznej wersji tłumaczenia, jego naukową transkrypcję oraz filologiczne uwagi tłumacza wraz z ich transkrypcją i przekładem na język angielski. Aneks zawiera sześć faksymiliów prezentowanego rękopisu. Cyfrowa wersja artykułu na stronie wydawnictwa Vandenhoeck & Ruprecht Verlage/Brill uzupełniona jest dwoma plikami audio: przekładem wspomnianego tekstu oraz komentarzem tłumacza. Oba czytane są przez Amira Hlayyila.

The paper is a contribution to the field of Arabic dialectology, more precisely to the knowledge of contemporary artistic production in Lebanese. The article presents a unique
manuscript translation of the excerpt from James Joyce’s Ulysses, the last passage of Molly Bloom’s soliloquy, written in the stream of consciousness narrative technique. Its translator is Amir Hlayyil, Maronite poet and an ethnographer from Kfar Shima in southern al-Matn. The paper includes a collation of two versions of the translation, dialectological commentary along with the analysis of the idiosyncrasies of spelling in the manuscript, typescript in the Arabic alphabet of the final version of the translation, its transcription, Hlayyil’s philological glosses with their transcription, and the English translation. The appendix contains six facsimiles of the presented document. The open access version of the paper is supplemented by two audio files read by Amir Hlayyil: his translation and commentary.

Philomaths’ programmatic and organizational writings and their private correspondence, poetic works, and customs are analyzed, which are characteristic of this milieu. Cicero’s dialogue "Lelius on Friendship" – situated here in the context of the widely outlined classical interpretation and valorization of friendship (Pythagoras, Plato, Aristotle, Seneca the Younger, Christian thought) – is indicated one of the foundations of the Philomaths’ understanding and experience of friendship. Also included in the sphere of reference is the question of the course and quality of classical education of Mickiewicz and his peers and the peculiarities of Vilnius’s classical philology in the first decades of the 19th century.

results.title: North African states not bordering Western Sahara in the face of the problem of its independence

abstracts.content: The issue of Western Sahara has been a major source of division in the North African region for over fifty years. This problem not only impacts political relations but also hinders economic cooperation. The division between states supporting Western Sahara's independence and those backing Morocco's stance has created strong polarisation, not only within the region but also across the African continent and the Middle East. The aim of this chapter is to analyse the attitudes of North African countries not bordering the territory of Western Sahara, namely Libya, Tunisia, and Egypt, toward the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic (SADR) and the question of its independence, both before and after the Arab Spring. The analysis considers the region's history, with a focus on the Arab Spring as a significant turning point. The outbreak of the Arab Spring caused a political reshuffle in the North African states, and among many changes, there was also a shift in the approach of Libya and Egipt towards the Western Sahara issue, while Tunisia consistently attempted to implement a policy of positive neutrality.
